clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—软件使用安全要求
clauses.scope_note: Applies to Baidu-provided services or software. Without Baidu’s written permission, the user must not modify, translate, adapt, rent, sublicense, disseminate over information networks, or transfer them; reverse engineering, decompilation, and attempts to discover source code are also barred. No general permission to do these acts is granted.
clauses.condition_explanation: The listed acts are barred unless Baidu has given written permission.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—通信服务资料合法性要求
clauses.scope_note: Applies to materials uploaded to a communication service and downloaded by the user; the text says those materials may be subject to public restrictions on use, copying, and/or distribution, which the user must observe.
clauses.condition_explanation: The obligation is triggered when the user downloads such material. The applicable restrictions are not specified in this excerpt.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—禁止有害信息散布
clauses.scope_note: In using communication services, the user must not upload or otherwise provide files containing protected images, photographs, software, or other materials unless the user owns or controls the rights or has obtained all necessary permissions; use of materials obtained through the service must not infringe another party’s listed or other proprietary rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: The upload prohibition applies when the material is protected and the user neither owns or controls the relevant rights nor has all necessary permissions. The separate non-infringement requirement applies when using materials obtained through the service.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—禁止有害信息散布
clauses.scope_note: The user must not falsify or delete copyright-management information, including authorship, legal or other notices, proprietary marks, or source/origin labels contained in uploaded files.
clauses.condition_explanation: This prohibition applies to falsifying or deleting the specified information.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—资源使用合法性要求
clauses.scope_note: Applies to use of Baidu’s cloud platform resources, including servers, bandwidth, and storage. Excessive resource occupation, including by programs or processes, is prohibited when it creates the described serious, unreasonable load or disruption; the stated consequence is forced host shutdown and possible account freezing.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition is tied to both excessive resource occupation and the specified serious, unreasonable impact; ordinary resource use is not addressed by this clause.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—用户行为限制性要求
clauses.scope_note: The user may not use the service to conduct DDoS-protection or DNS-protection sales unless the user has purchased a service specifically for that purpose.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction does not apply to the stated activity when the user has purchased a service specifically intended for it.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—用户行为合法性要求
clauses.scope_note: Applies to use of Baidu services and to facilitating the listed conduct, including conduct by the user’s end users. The listed restrictions include renting cloud servers as virtual servers or disk space, using them as proxy or email servers, specified unlawful activity and spam, harmful resource overuse, attacks or security compromise, disruption or interference with service operation, and malicious alteration, removal, falsification, or concealment of Baidu-provided AI-generated-content identifiers. This is a conduct restriction, not a general grant or prohibition on modifying or combining software.
clauses.condition_explanation: The prohibition applies when the user uses the service for, or facilitates, one or more of the activities listed in this section. The clause’s separate examples and qualifications remain applicable; for example, it does not prohibit every commercial use or every network service.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—出口管制与制裁
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the user and persons the user authorizes to use Baidu products or services. They must not provide controlled products or services through them to prohibited destinations, entities, or persons without the relevant competent-authority permission, and the user must not use Baidu products or services for a prohibited purpose.
clauses.condition_explanation: The restriction is triggered by an applicable export-control or sanctions prohibition; providing to a prohibited destination, entity, or person is excepted only where the required competent-authority permission has been obtained.

clauses.clause_label: 用户的权利与义务—AI生成输出对外发布或传播
clauses.scope_note: Applies when the user externally publishes or transmits output generated by an AI model in the service. The user must check truthfulness and accuracy, fulfill applicable legal and regulatory labeling duties, and avoid publishing or transmitting output that violates law or the agreement.
clauses.condition_explanation: All three listed duties are triggered by external publication or transmission of the service’s AI-model-generated output.

clauses.clause_label: 关于百度智能云账号—账号注册
clauses.scope_note: Applies to the user’s Baidu account used to access services, not to a grant of rights in the services or software. Only the user may use that account; transfer, gift, or inheritance is barred unless Baidu consents and the account’s real-name registration is changed.
clauses.condition_explanation: The transfer-related prohibition applies in the absence of both Baidu consent and a real-name account change.

clauses.clause_label: 声明及总则—协议适用与服务规则
clauses.scope_note: Concerns use of Baidu Smart Cloud products and services, not a software copyright license. Acceptance or use binds the user to this agreement and service rules formally published or displayed as described; specific products or services may have their own terms. Continued use after announced amendments signifies acceptance of the amended terms.
clauses.condition_explanation: Use is governed by the agreement and applicable service rules, including relevant product-specific terms and announced amendments accepted through continued use.

clauses.clause_label: 百度智能云的权利与义务—关联账户管理
clauses.scope_note: For Baidu products or services with account-authorization functionality, the user may authorize specified accounts to perform all or part of service operations. Actions by an authorized account are treated as the user’s actions, and the user bears resulting responsibility and service fees.
clauses.condition_explanation: This applies only where the product or service has the stated authorization feature and the user grants authorization; fees are the user’s responsibility for resulting service use, not a right to charge others.

coverage_notes: This is a general Baidu Smart Cloud user-service agreement, not an identified repository software or model license. OriginalArtifact therefore denotes the Baidu-provided services/software or, where specified, the user’s service account; the excerpt grants no general rights to copy, modify, distribute, sublicense, combine, train on, or commercially exploit a software/model artifact.

Specific product terms and service rules, including displayed billing standards and product-specific terms, are incorporated or may apply but are not supplied here. Their applicability and any detailed permissions, prices, usage limits, or service-specific data/output rights cannot be determined from this excerpt.

No general training permission, training prohibition, source-provision duty, copyleft term, patent-retaliation term, or general right to charge for or sell copies is stated. The restrictions on listed conduct should not be read as universal prohibitions on all commercial use, hosting, networking, or combinations.

Lines 114–163 contain additional restrictions on unlawful or harmful information and communication-service conduct; the extracted clauses include the provisions directly addressing rights-protected material, copying/distribution notices, and commercial advertising, but do not enumerate every content category.
